title: the two pack characters (Chad and Chadaline, working names)
lensAText: a sceptical game art director. Open the pack's reference sheets (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/owner/pack/chad/body-sheet.png and face-sheet.png; /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/owner/pack/chadaline/body-sheet.webp and face-sheet.webp) with the Read tool and compare them with the builder's renders view by view: is each clearly recognisable as THAT character (build and height, skin tone, face shape, hair, outfit and colours, accessories), at least as good as the six base characters, striking and premium as the owner wants ('insanely attractive' super characters) while tasteful and non-explicit, an original character in the game's stylised look (not a likeness of a real person), the heels' soles plain black (no red soles), readable at phone size and free of artefacts? Take your own frames in ONE short Playwright script on dist/artifact.html at 390x844 (phone viewport copy, DPR 3) and 1450x767: the picker showing them locked as the pack ('coming soon', $22.22, 18+), the dev test unlock clearly labelled as a test, and each in Lot 57 and Stoppage Time and in the seat view with the arms (steer to full lock: no clipping, popping or stutter).
brief: THE OWNER (2026-11-11 ~6:15 PM PT and after): a premium two-character pack ('Chad / Chadaline', working names; the male and female versions of each other; names may change), $22.22 with the Rossini Scarlatta, 18+ purchase; and (~9:05 PM PT): "make the six characters including the chad top priority". THIS LANE builds the TWO PACK CHARACTERS on top of the reviewed six-character work on this branch (claude/cast: src/onfoot/cast.ts catalog, the people-builder additions, the main-menu Character entry and picker, the driver match, PROJECT_OC_CAST.md: read them first). References (look at all four): /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/owner/pack/chad/body-sheet.png and face-sheet.png (tall athletic build, dark-brown curly hair with lighter tips, black double-breasted peak-lapel suit, white pocket square, white open-collar shirt, black lace-up shoes, small stud earrings; brown eyes, strong brows, light stubble) and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/owner/pack/chadaline/body-sheet.webp and face-sheet.webp (long dark wavy hair, black spaghetti-strap fitted mini dress, cream faux-fur shrug worn off the shoulders, gold watch, rings and small hoops, black pointed stiletto heels; brown eyes, full brows and lashes). Notes in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/owner/pack/plan.md. BUILD: (1) both as entries in the cast catalog with unlock category 'pack' (stable IDs, names as working names, portraits cropped from the face sheets as small inlined WebP, people-builder params, heights, wardrobe, animation); (2) the builder features they need, ADDITIVE ONLY in src/onfoot/people/* (curly medium hair, long straight/wavy hair, a double-breasted suit jacket with pocket square, an open-collar shirt, a fitted mini dress, an off-the-shoulder faux-fur shrug, stiletto heels with PLAIN BLACK soles (the red sole is a real brand's trademark), stud and small hoop earrings, rings); avoid face.ts, masks.ts and skin.ts unless truly needed (say so); (3) the picker shows them as the locked pack: preview and turntable allowed, 'Chad & Chadaline pack: coming soon, $22.22, 18+', selection only with the pack entitlement (src/store entitlements; the store stays in test mode; a dev-only test unlock clearly labelled TEST); (4) when unlocked they work everywhere the six do: on foot in both venues and as the driver (arms, skin tone, sleeves: the suit cuff with a sliver of white shirt; Chadaline's bare forearms with the gold watch and rings), with the same first-person smoothness bar; (5) they are NOT added to the NPC pool; (6) the store's pack entry (added by the six-character lane) priced 2222 per the owner, grants the two characters and the Rossini Scarlatta (reserved, not built yet), available false. Quality bar (the owner, ~5:45 PM PT): 'make sure graphics are insane ... and it doesn't have any laggy graphics or act glitchy when 1st person POV with the arms': top quality on HD and Ultra; first-person arms glitch-free; MEASURE a 120 s seat-view drive on the phone profile (CDP CPU throttle 4) and desktop with each pack character as the driver vs the base: p95 frame time within +10 %, no heap growth. Our own brands; tasteful and non-explicit. ADD regression checks: both pack characters build within budget, are locked without the entitlement, unlock with it (test mode), never appear in the NPC pool, and the pack entry is 2222 and not for sale. PROVE: tsc; the build (owner-test mark); npm test -- --only=boot,phone,venues and the new checks; renders of each beside its body-sheet views and face-sheet views into tests/out/cast/pack-*.png; picker frames; one frame of each on foot and in the seat view.
